messages:
mira: Heads-up — I'm planning a prod overlay rollforward for svc-rate-limiter to pick up the Terraform secret path rename. Pushing in ~30m unless someone objects. Need quick sanity check on SA bindings and KMS alias change.

alex: quick Q — is this the change that moves secrets from /redwood/prod/ to /redwood/services/svc-rate-limiter/?

mira: yes. old path: /redwood/prod/svc-rate-limiter, new path: /redwood/services/svc-rate-limiter. We updated terraform var and added a kustomize patch.

jess: can you paste the kustomize patch? want to confirm env var refs.

mira: sure — snippet below: 
```yaml
# overlays/prod/svc-rate-limiter/secret-patch.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: svc-rate-limiter-config
data:
  SECRET_PATH: "/redwood/services/svc-rate-limiter"
```

mira: and TF var change: 
```hcl
variable "secrets_base_path" {
  type = string
  default = "/redwood/services"
}
# modules/secret/main.tf uses: "${var.secrets_base_path}/${var.service_name}"
```

alex: looks fine. did you update secretsmanager IAM policy to allow read on the new path?

mira: yes, module now creates a policy with resource: arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-west-2:123456789012:secret:/redwood/services/svc-rate-limiter/*

infra-bot: terraform plan for infra/prod returned: 
```
Plan: 2 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.
+ aws_secretsmanager_secret.target
+ aws_iam_policy.svc_rate_limiter_secret_read
```

sam: pinging on service account binding — the overlay adds a ServiceAccount annotation for eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn?

mira: yes annotated to use the existing iam role arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-prod-svc-rate-limiter. No new role created.

tyler: quick safety ask — does this touch any rotation config? if rotation ARNs change, ops needs to be notified.

mira: rotation config untouched. only path and policy. secrets rotation lambda continues to target tag: service=svc-rate-limiter.

jess: ok from me, simple path rename. :+1:

alex: ran kustomize build locally, saw the configmap and SA annotation. command I used: `kustomize build overlays/prod/svc-rate-limiter | kubectl apply -f - --dry-run=client` — no validation errors.

mira: thanks. I'll trigger the staged apply: 1) terraform apply infra/prod, 2) apply kustomize overlay canary to 2 pods, 3) promote. Doing step 1 now.

infra-bot: terraform apply started for infra/prod by mira. run id: tf-apply-2026-03-17-01

sam: quick note — after apply, confirm the secret ARN and update the secret mount tests in staging before full promote.

mira: will do. If terraform apply finishes clean and canary kustomize patch is fine, I'll rollforward to prod at +45m.

tyler: if you want a rollback runbook: keep the old secret path present for 24h and revert configmap to old path and redeploy — that should restore reads. :eyes:

mira: good call. I left a backup configmap in the repo under overlays/prod/svc-rate-limiter/backup-old-path.yaml

alex: all good from infra side, go for apply. :rocket:

mira: applying now. will update thread once canary passes or if any failures. Thanks all.
